experiment_Name: Method A v8 CODE-ACCORD expanded passage, matched cases
experiment_Description: Controlled non-direct-QA comparison, Method A. Uses the v8 keyword-centered physical-line window algorithm with 15 lines before and after each hit. CODE-ACCORD search terms are derived from the dataset question because the historical German value-key map does not support value='value'; this is an explicit input adaptation. Uses the same Gemma 4 31B, temperature 1.0, and five repetitions as direct-QA reference runs. Historical Exp. 11 used Gemma 3 27B and tested multiple window sizes, so this is a method-configuration comparison, not a pure model-controlled comparison to Exp. 11.
